annotations.text:
Survivor 51 pool — phone screens, left to right in the order a friend sees them.

The pick screens work: tap a castaway's photo to select, tap Submit. Colours and layout match the live site.

Leave feedback on anything: wording, what's missing, what's confusing.
Join: pick your name or create one with a PIN. Question: is a PIN worth the friction, or honour system?
Pre-merge picks: official cast photos, one grid per tribe (two tribes this season). Tap to select, tap again to clear. Title-line bonus is a smaller grid below.
Post-merge: tap three photos in order for #1 / #2 / #3 (150 / 75 / 40). Same screen is reused for the finale with 'Who wins the season?'
Leaderboard: one column per scored episode, your row highlighted. Ties share a rank.
Episode results: everyone's picks revealed after the deadline. Green = hit, struck through = miss.
Commissioner view: tick who went home, pick the title-line sayer, finalize. Try it: tick a name, tick Finalized, Save.
